# evroc_filestore (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc FileStore.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the file store to query.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the file store was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nfs_endpoint` (String) NFS server IP or hostname for mounting.
- `nfs_export_path` (String) NFS export path on the server.
- `nfs_version` (String) NFS protocol version.
- `region` (String) Region where the file store is located.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status.
- `zone` (String) Availability zone of the file store.
